title: Summed cubewise Poincaré bound from the translation estimate (Simon 5.1, (32))
statement:
For every m ∈ ℕ (with n := m + 1) there is c ∈ [0, ∞) with the following property. Let ρ > 0, let u : ℝ^n → ℝ be measurable, and let Λ ∈ [0, ∞] satisfy ∫⁻ |u(x + h) − u(x)| dx ≤ ‖h‖·Λ for all h ∈ ℝ^n. Then
Σ'_{F ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n n} ρ^{−n} ∫⁻_{latticeFace ρ F} ∫⁻_{latticeFace ρ F} |u(x) − u(y)| dy dx ≤ c·ρ·Λ
in [0, ∞], where ρ^{−n} is written ENNReal.ofReal (ρ^n)⁻¹.
lean_statement: ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (u : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), Measurable u → (∀ h : Eucl (m + 1), ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u (x + h) - u x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * Λ) → ∑' F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in latticeFace ρ F, ∫⁻ y in latticeFace ρ F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * Λ
